text:
Priya Singh: Heads-up: SummitSpark hands-on workshop next Tue. We're co-presenting a cloud marketplace demo with EdgeWave. Need final runbook: speaker order, live demo fallback, kit pickup, and swag table layout.

Owen Park: I'll own routing & rollback. Plan: live on EdgeWave appliance -> fallback to Redwood Dedicated eu-west. Canary 70/30. If p95 > 800ms or any 5xx spike, flip.

Riley Fox: I'll be doing speaker ops. Draft order: intro (Priya) 5m, marketplace listing demo (EdgeWave) 12m, Redwood infra deep-dive 10m, live Q&A 8m. Final slides due Mon 15:00 PT.

Marta Silva: Kits ready. Manifest: RDW-SPARK-LABKIT x10. Courier: FastLane (AWB FL56789). ETA Mon afternoon. I uploaded packing manifest: https://drive.example/rdw/summitspark/manifest.pdf.

Owen Park: Quick health check for EdgeWave before we ship: `ssh edge@10.2.1.3 'systemctl status redwood-edge'` should show active. Also script to simulate traffic (light):

```
for n in {1..20}; do curl -s -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' &
done
wait
```

Priya Singh: Swag: 100 sticker packs, 50 beanies, 30 notebooks. Can we get a small A-frame sign with "Redwood x EdgeWave"? Design in Drive: `SUMMITSPARK-SWAG.png`.

Riley Fox: AV checklist: HDMI, adaptors (USB-C, miniDP), 2x powered USB hubs, ethernet cable, local battery pack. Need one volunteer on-site 90 min prior. @Marta can you confirm local contact?

Marta Silva: Local contact is Jonah +44-20-555-1234. FastLane confirmed customs docs required for EU; I uploaded commercial invoice and ECCN.

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal Mon 18:00 UTC — calendar invite sent to participants.

Owen Park: Observability: sending traces to shared collector, Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/summitspark. SLO: error_rate < 0.75% during demo window. Alert will trigger Slack webhook to #incidents.

Priya Singh: Marketing wants a short announcement to post T+15m. Draft copy in Drive; legal needs to OK by Mon noon. Also want a 60s fallback video hosted on S3 in case live demo fails.

Riley Fox: I'll bring a USB with the fallback video and upload to S3 as well.

Marta Silva: FastLane tracking: https://fastlane.example/track/FL56789. Onsite pickup by Jonah Tue 08:30.

Priya Singh: Action items recap: @Owen run failover test by Mon EOD; @Marta confirm customs + courier AM check Mon; @Riley finalize slides + upload fallback video Mon 15:00; legal signoff on copy by Mon 12:00. React with :thumbsup: when done.

Owen Park: :thumbsup: will run tests Mon.

Marta Silva: :thumbsup: courier confirming Mon AM.

Riley Fox: :thumbsup: slides + video in Drive.

ops-bot: Note: Bring two printed emergency contacts and the venue liability waiver copy.
